notes: Stories already complete (5/5). Minor dependency alignment added to reflect reliance on provider quality data (NPI/state). No new IDs created.

change_log.note: Link construction depends on NPI/state fields from provider quality feature

stories.title: Define External Link Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and standardize the external link schema to include site_name, url, label, and guidance_text. Ensure guidance text clearly explains how to interpret each source (NPI Registry = official data, Healthgrades = consumer reviews, state boards = license verification) and aligns with provider_detail_service output structure.

stories.title: Implement External Link Construction Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic link construction using NPI and state from provider data. Ensure correct URL patterns for NPI Registry, Healthgrades search/profile, and supported state medical boards (DE, MS, VA). Include fallback handling when state-specific board links are unavailable.

stories.title: Integrate URL Validation for External Links
stories.description: Pass all constructed links through url_guardian for validation, sanitization, and correction (HEAD check, AI verification, fallback). Ensure invalid or unreachable links are either corrected or excluded before reaching the facade.

stories.title: Expose External Links via EvaluateCare Facade and UI Rendering
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include validated external links in the provider detail response. Render links in the frontend with labels and inline guidance (tooltip or helper text) ensuring clarity and safe navigation.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for External Links
stories.description: Implement unit tests for schema validation and link construction, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from provider_detail_service through facade to frontend-ready payload. Include cases for missing NPI, unsupported states, and invalid URLs.
